messages:
maria: saw a canary spike — ~8% fncall rejections from partner-adapter in eu-west. sample error: `invalid_schema: extra_field 'attachments'` — example payload below
aj: ugh. is this adapter sending legacy `attachments`? our validator should coerce, not hard reject for canary
kevin: rejections are getting counted as failed invokes and hitting quota dashboards. billing tag shows route=prod even for canary :grimace:
priyanka: dashboard doesn't show sampling rate for validation rejections; ops can't tell if it's noisy canary or prod bug. need `validation_sample_rate` on the metric
maria: exact log: ```json
{"request_id":"r-1234","hook":"actionhook","params":{"text":"hi","attachments":[...]}}
error: invalid_schema: unexpected key 'attachments'
```
samir: we already have `soft_validate` flag in API but it wasn't wired into partner adapters. two options: 1) auto-coerce arrays into empty object or 2) route to permissive model variant (lower-cost) and tag as `soft_reject`
aj: prefer route->permissive + tag. keeps UX predictable and avoids silent coercions
kevin: agree, but routing currently attributes quota to the original route. We need to ensure fallback route doesn't increment prod quota. that's the billing bug
priyanka: propose adding `validation_route` metadata to metrics and console so we can filter by final_route vs requested_route
maria: UX request: console -> toolcall errors should show raw payload + first failing schema rule. right now it's just `invalid_schema`
samir: should also record sample request with `redact: true` for PII; storage TTL 7d
deploy-bot: canary rollout: actionhook-soft-validate=on for 15% traffic (started)
kevin: can we patch telemetry quickly to emit event `validation_fallthrough` with keys: original_route, final_route, sample_rate, reject_reason
priyanka: +1. I'll file a quick console dashboard card: "Validation fallthroughs" with filter by region/route
maria: action items: priyanka - dashboard card, samir - hook wiring for soft_validate, kevin - ensure billing attribution fix, aj - write short RFC for permissive route semantics
aj: will do RFC today, ping me for review :thumbsup:
priyanka: tagging @eng-sre to keep an eye on eu-west spike :eyes:
maria: thanks everyone — let's meet 11:30 to sync if telemetry patch isn't up by then :calendar:
